private_policy_additions: Title notification: the I5 settlement-mail seam requires attachments, so LEGEND_KUAFU_MAIL (text only) is not sent; Sunday titles reach players only as PlayerDisplay title origins.

A match ends as soon as its winner is decided (user-approved 2026-10-20): every round is frozen at START, then each wave resolves in parallel the fewest rounds that could decide the match; rounds after the decision are never simulated and their Combat attempts stay STAGED without a result. Report keys, wins, usage and history cover only the played rounds.
A match whose round can no longer resolve is closed without result and keeps its consumed try or promotion chance; a different START while an earlier match is open first finishes that match.
An identical START within 60 s of the previous one (or while it is open) returns the recorded match; results are due within 10 min.
GET_ENEMY_TEAM serves any competitor (the rank list opens it), hiding the last team_hide teams; missing teams render empty.
The rank lists (301 rank_types 3 global, 4 server) show the top 50; score is the slot for Master/Senior and points for Juniors.
Record detail (2489) serves any retained record, including records shared through chat; an expired record answers {}.
2485 without a report key returns the round report keys of the player's retained defense records, newest first.
A defender's saved teams beyond the group's team count are ignored (first N used); a Junior demoted by a promotion swap keeps its saved teams.
Records keep a viewer-side is_win (the record owner's result), as Top Floor does.

START answers within 25 s (the stock client waits 30 s for this form-data request); rounds still resolving then answer unavailable/unresolved, resolution continues detached and deduplicated per attempt in-process, an identical START returns the settled result and the reconcile provider settles it regardless (worst case: Master best-of-seven with 5-hero teams).
deviations_from_plan: PlayerDisplay CatalogExternalOrigins is a CatalogOriginRoutes router (girls ranking 100059-100062, 1 on 1 100002-100005); the 1 on 1 origin read is composed without Combat so titles stay readable when the combat key ring is absent.
Combat usage parsing (combat.Usage/PartnerUse) moved from domain/topfloor to domain/combat so both modes share one report parser; Top Floor behaviour unchanged (5B native tests rerun).
contentstore.readModeCatalog is the shared strict reader for game-mode catalogs (Top Floor and 1 on 1).
gxb-api runReconcile is one 30 s loop per mode provider (Top Floor, 1 on 1).
Junior players hold slot NULL so the deferrable (competition_id, slot) uniqueness spans Master/Senior only (found by native tests).
Achievement streaks are keyed by (player, achievement); 100001 Top Floor rows unchanged.

Combat resolver adapter (SNAPSHOT_ONLY_ADAPTERS_V1 unchanged): bootstrap now materializes a PEAK_ARENA model stub and the driver passes {team1=...} groups only for CampaignType 65, which previously failed closed (COMBAT_ADAPTER_UNMATERIALIZED_MODEL); every other campaign's snapshot replays byte-identically and the rules corpus id is unaffected.
combat.StartManyTx (5A amendment) stages all of a match's rounds with one shared freezer; each snapshot lists only its own battle's players.
contentstore memoizes the spirit, element, inscription and stat catalogs per immutable revision (they were decoded on every hero stat read).
START admission reads the competition root without locking it (admission changes no position; position changes conflict on the locked player rows); settlement and transitions lock it.
known_limitations: One competition over all logical servers serializes every 1 on 1 mutation on the competition root (lock 602); adequate for private-server scale.
Standings are computed from the full competitor list on each read (no rank index); adequate for private-server scale.
1829 SUPER_ARENA history projection, the exchange shop (ShopType.TOP) and old Peak MIDs 560-571 stay unactivated.
Promotion success after the locked opponent has left the target group still swaps with that opponent's current position (rare; no extra guard).

Worst-case Master/Senior matches with full 5-hero teams need a second identical START (or the reconcile provider) to deliver the result; resolution of a 5v5 round takes about 22 s on 12 cores (5A engine cost).

A close match (for example 2-1, 3-2 or 4-3) needs one to three further resolution waves, so a Master/Senior START reaches the 25 s budget more often than a sweep; the identical retry or the reconcile provider returns the result.
lock_order: actor fence 315 -> 1 on 1 competition root 602 (settlement, transitions, match settlement; START admission reads it unlocked) -> 1 on 1 player rows (player order) -> Combat locator 609 -> I5 mail 610 -> Achievement 620 -> I5 value 700+; scheduled settlements and promotion transitions each run in their own transaction before any competition mutation (settle-before-mutate).
